authbind_lib.description: Explicit path to libauthbind.so.1.0. Corresponds to AUTHBIND_LIB environment variable. Empty string uses the compiled-in default.

authbind_depth.description: Maximum depth of child process tree affected by authbind (--depth N). Default is 1. Corresponds to the --depth or --deep options.

authbind_access_entries.description: Access control entries defining which address:port combinations users may bind to. Each entry defines a file in /etc/authbind/ that, if executable by the user, grants permission to bind to that port/address pair.
